fullText.simplified:
回家

    “江东就在前面！大家快跑！”孙坚大声说。
    孙坚身后跟着两百多人，他们都在努力往前跑。这两百多人是孙坚的军队，前面的江东是他们的家。
    几个月前，孙坚带着军队从江东出来，和国家的其他军队一起打董卓。打完董卓，孙坚再带着军队回江东。从江东出来的时候，孙坚的军队有一万多人，现在只有两百多人了。人变少不是因为董卓，孙坚打董卓没有败过。孙坚的军队是在回来的路上变少的，因为一个叫刘表的人。
    刘表的家在荆州，离江东很近。荆州是南方的大城，刘表是荆州最重要的人。两天前，刘表带着军队，在孙坚回江东的路上等他。刘表说孙坚身上有国宝，要孙坚把国宝给他。孙坚说没有，刘表不相信，就要打孙坚。刘表想的是，等把孙坚打败了，就可以从他身上拿到国宝了。
    国宝是很重要的东西，几百年前的皇帝用过，现在的皇帝也用过。很多人都认为，谁有国宝，谁就可以做皇帝。在这个不安静的国家里，每个人都想做皇帝，每个人都想要国宝。
    刘表的人多，孙坚的人少，孙坚没办法，带着军队一边打一边往江东跑。他们打了两天，也跑了两天，孙坚的人越来越少。
    前面的山不高，山的那一边就是江东。到了江东，大家就安全了。但是现在，每个人都累极了，马也累极了，大家都慢了下来。
    刘表的军队很快就跟上来了。虽然刘表已经杀了很多人，但他还没有拿到国宝。他很生气，对军队大声说：“杀了孙坚！拿国宝！”
fullText.traditional:
回家

    “江東就在前面！大家快跑！”孫堅大聲說。
    孫堅身後跟著兩百多人，他們都在努力往前跑。這兩百多人是孫堅的軍隊，前面的江東是他們的家。
    幾個月前，孫堅帶著軍隊從江東出來，和國家的其他軍隊一起打董卓。打完董卓，孫堅再帶著軍隊回江東。從江東出來的時候，孫堅的軍隊有一萬多人，現在只有兩百多人了。人變少不是因為董卓，孫堅打董卓沒有敗過。孫堅的軍隊是在回來的路上變少的，因為一個叫劉表的人。
    劉表的家在荊州，離江東很近。荊州是南方的大城，劉表是荊州最重要的人。兩天前，劉表帶著軍隊，在孫堅回江東的路上等他。劉表說孫堅身上有國寶，要孫堅把國寶給他。孫堅說沒有，劉表不相信，就要打孫堅。劉表想的是，等把孫堅打敗了，就可以從他身上拿到國寶了。
    國寶是很重要的東西，幾百年前的皇帝用過，現在的皇帝也用過。很多人都認為，誰有國寶，誰就可以做皇帝。在這個不安靜的國家裡，每個人都想做皇帝，每個人都想要國寶。
    劉表的人多，孫堅的人少，孫堅沒辦法，帶著軍隊一邊打一邊往江東跑。他們打了兩天，也跑了兩天，孫堅的人越來越少。
    前面的山不高，山的那一邊就是江東。到了江東，大家就安全了。但是現在，每個人都累極了，馬也累極了，大家都慢了下來。
    劉表的軍隊很快就跟上來了。雖然劉表已經殺了很多人，但他還沒有拿到國寶。他很生氣，對軍隊大聲說：“殺了孫堅！拿國寶！”

sentences.simplified: “江东就在前面！大家快跑！”孙坚大声说。
sentences.traditional: “江東就在前面！大家快跑！”孫堅大聲說。
sentences.pinyin: jiāng dōng jiù zài qián miàn dà jiā kuài pǎo sūn jiān dà shēng shuō
sentences.english: “Jiangdong is ahead! Everybody run!” Sun Jian said loudly.

sentences.simplified: 孙坚身后跟着两百多人，他们都在努力往前跑。
sentences.traditional: 孫堅身後跟著兩百多人，他們都在努力往前跑。
sentences.pinyin: sūn jiān shēn hòu gēn zhe liǎng bǎi duō rén tā men dōu zài nǔ lì wǎng qián pǎo
sentences.english: Sun Jian was followed by more than 200 men. They were all exerting effort to run forwards.

sentences.simplified: 这两百多人是孙坚的军队，前面的江东是他们的家。
sentences.traditional: 這兩百多人是孫堅的軍隊，前面的江東是他們的家。
sentences.pinyin: zhè liǎng bǎi duō rén shì sūn jiān de jūn duì qián miàn de jiāng dōng shì tā men de jiā
sentences.english: These 200 or so men were Sun Jian’s troops and Jiangdong, in front of them, was their home.

sentences.simplified: 几个月前，孙坚带着军队从江东出来，和国家的其他军队一起打董卓。
sentences.traditional: 幾個月前，孫堅帶著軍隊從江東出來，和國家的其他軍隊一起打董卓。
sentences.pinyin: jǐ ge yuè qián sūn jiān dài zhe jūn duì cóng jiāng dōng chū lái hé guó jiā de qí tā jūn duì yì qǐ dǎ dǒng zhuó
sentences.english: Several months previously, Sun Jian had brought his troops out of Jiangdong to fight Dong Zhuo alongside other troops in the country.

sentences.simplified: 打完董卓，孙坚再带着军队回江东。
sentences.traditional: 打完董卓，孫堅再帶著軍隊回江東。
sentences.pinyin: dǎ wán dǒng zhuó sūn jiān zài dài zhe jūn duì huí jiāng dōng
sentences.english: After fighting Dong Zhuo, Sun Jian then brought his troops back to Jiangdong.

sentences.simplified: 从江东出来的时候，孙坚的军队有一万多人，现在只有两百多人了。
sentences.traditional: 從江東出來的時候，孫堅的軍隊有一萬多人，現在只有兩百多人了。
sentences.pinyin: cóng jiāng dōng chū lái de shí hou sūn jiān de jūn duì yǒu yí wàn duō rén xiàn zài zhǐ yǒu liǎng bǎi duō rén le
sentences.english: When they left Jiangdong, Sun Jian had more than 10,000 troops, but now there were only 200 or so.

sentences.simplified: 人变少不是因为董卓，孙坚打董卓没有败过。
sentences.traditional: 人變少不是因為董卓，孫堅打董卓沒有敗過。
sentences.pinyin: rén biàn shǎo bú shì yīn wèi dǒng zhuó sūn jiān dǎ dǒng zhuó méi yǒu bài guò
sentences.english: The loss of men was not because of Dong Zhuo, as Sun Jian had never lost a battle against Dong Zhuo.

sentences.simplified: 孙坚的军队是在回来的路上变少的，因为一个叫刘表的人。
sentences.traditional: 孫堅的軍隊是在回來的路上變少的，因為一個叫劉表的人。
sentences.pinyin: sūn jiān de jūn duì shì zài huí lái de lù shang biàn shǎo de yīn wèi yí ge jiào liú biǎo de rén
sentences.english: Sun Jian lost troops on the way back because of a man named Liu Biao.

sentences.simplified: 刘表的家在荆州，离江东很近。
sentences.traditional: 劉表的家在荊州，離江東很近。
sentences.pinyin: liú biǎo de jiā zài jīng zhōu lí jiāng dōng hěn jìn
sentences.english: Liu Biao’s home was in Jingzhou, which was very close to Jiangdong.

sentences.simplified: 荆州是南方的大城，刘表是荆州最重要的人。
sentences.traditional: 荊州是南方的大城，劉表是荊州最重要的人。
sentences.pinyin: jīng zhōu shì nán fāng de dà chéng liú biǎo shì jīng zhōu zuì zhòng yào de rén
sentences.english: Jingzhou was a large city in the south, and Liu Biao was the most important person in Jingzhou.

sentences.simplified: 两天前，刘表带着军队，在孙坚回江东的路上等他。
sentences.traditional: 兩天前，劉表帶著軍隊，在孫堅回江東的路上等他。
sentences.pinyin: liǎng tiān qián liú biǎo dài zhe jūn duì zài sūn jiān huí jiāng dōng de lù shang děng tā
sentences.english: Two days previously, Liu Biao and his troops were waiting for Sun Jian on his way back to Jiangdong.

sentences.simplified: 刘表说孙坚身上有国宝，要孙坚把国宝给他。
sentences.traditional: 劉表說孫堅身上有國寶，要孫堅把國寶給他。
sentences.pinyin: liú biǎo shuō sūn jiān shēn shang yǒu guó bǎo yào sūn jiān bǎ guó bǎo gěi tā
sentences.english: Liu Biao said that Sun Jian had a national treasure, and he wanted Sun Jian to give him the national treasure.

sentences.simplified: 孙坚说没有，刘表不相信，就要打孙坚。
sentences.traditional: 孫堅說沒有，劉表不相信，就要打孫堅。
sentences.pinyin: sūn jiān shuō méi yǒu liú biǎo bù xiāng xìn jiù yào dǎ sūn jiān
sentences.english: Sun Jian said he didn’t have it. Liu Biao didn’t believe him, so he wanted to fight Sun Jian.

sentences.simplified: 刘表想的是，等把孙坚打败了，就可以从他身上拿到国宝了。
sentences.traditional: 劉表想的是，等把孫堅打敗了，就可以從他身上拿到國寶了。
sentences.pinyin: liú biǎo xiǎng de shì děng bǎ sūn jiān dǎ bài le jiù kě yǐ cóng tā shēn shang ná dào guó bǎo le
sentences.english: Liu Biao thought that after he defeated Sun Jian, he could get the national treasure from him.

sentences.simplified: 国宝是很重要的东西，几百年前的皇帝用过，现在的皇帝也用过。
sentences.traditional: 國寶是很重要的東西，幾百年前的皇帝用過，現在的皇帝也用過。
sentences.pinyin: guó bǎo shì hěn zhòng yào de dōng xi jǐ bǎi nián qián de huáng dì yòng guò xiàn zài de huáng dì yě yòng guò
sentences.english: The national treasure was very important. It was used by emperors hundreds of years ago, and it was also used by the current emperor.

sentences.simplified: 很多人都认为，谁有国宝，谁就可以做皇帝。
sentences.traditional: 很多人都認為，誰有國寶，誰就可以做皇帝。
sentences.pinyin: hěn duō rén dōu rèn wéi shéi yǒu guó bǎo shéi jiù kě yǐ zuò huáng dì
sentences.english: Many people believed that whoever had the national treasure could become the emperor.

sentences.simplified: 在这个不安静的国家里，每个人都想做皇帝，每个人都想要国宝。
sentences.traditional: 在這個不安靜的國家裡，每個人都想做皇帝，每個人都想要國寶。
sentences.pinyin: zài zhè ge bù ān jìng de guó jiā lǐ měi ge rén dōu xiǎng zuò huáng dì měi ge rén dōu xiǎng yào guó bǎo
sentences.english: In this restless country, everyone wanted to be the emperor, and everyone wanted the national treasure.

sentences.simplified: 刘表的人多，孙坚的人少，
sentences.traditional: 劉表的人多，孫堅的人少，
sentences.pinyin: liú biǎo de rén duō sūn jiān de rén shǎo
sentences.english: Liu Biao had many men, and Sun Jian had few men.

sentences.simplified: 孙坚没办法，带着军队一边打一边往江东跑。
sentences.traditional: 孫堅沒辦法，帶著軍隊一邊打一邊往江東跑。
sentences.pinyin: sūn jiān méi bàn fǎ dài zhe jūn duì yì biān dǎ yì biān wǎng jiāng dōng pǎo
sentences.english: Sun Jian had no choice but to keep fighting while fleeing towards Jiangdong with his troops.

sentences.simplified: 他们打了两天，也跑了两天，孙坚的人越来越少。
sentences.traditional: 他們打了兩天，也跑了兩天，孫堅的人越來越少。
sentences.pinyin: tā men dǎ le liǎng tiān yě pǎo le liǎng tiān sūn jiān de rén yuè lái yuè shǎo
sentences.english: They fought for two days and fled for two days, and Sun Jian had fewer and fewer men.

sentences.simplified: 前面的山不高，山的那一边就是江东。
sentences.traditional: 前面的山不高，山的那一邊就是江東。
sentences.pinyin: qián miàn de shān bù gāo shān de nà yì biān jiù shì jiāng dōng
sentences.english: The mountains ahead were not high. Jiangdong was on the other side of the mountains.

sentences.simplified: 到了江东，大家就安全了。
sentences.traditional: 到了江東，大家就安全了。
sentences.pinyin: dào le jiāng dōng dà jiā jiù ān quán le
sentences.english: When they reached Jiangdong, everyone would be safe.

sentences.simplified: 但是现在，每个人都累极了，马也累极了，大家都慢了下来。
sentences.traditional: 但是現在，每個人都累極了，馬也累極了，大家都慢了下來。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì xiàn zài měi ge rén dōu lèi jí le mǎ yě lèi jí le dà jiā dōu màn le xià lái
sentences.english: But right now, everyone was extremely tired. The horses were also extremely tired. They had all slowed down.

sentences.simplified: 刘表的军队很快就跟上来了。
sentences.traditional: 劉表的軍隊很快就跟上來了。
sentences.pinyin: liú biǎo de jūn duì hěn kuài jiù gēn shàng lái le
sentences.english: Liu Biao’s troops caught up very quickly.

sentences.simplified: 虽然刘表已经杀了很多人，但他还没有拿到国宝。
sentences.traditional: 雖然劉表已經殺了很多人，但他還沒有拿到國寶。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán liú biǎo yǐ jīng shā le hěn duō rén dàn tā hái méi yǒu ná dào guó bǎo
sentences.english: Even though Liu Biao had already killed many men, he had not yet obtained the national treasure.

sentences.simplified: 他很生气，对军队大声说：“杀了孙坚！拿国宝！”
sentences.traditional: 他很生氣，對軍隊大聲說：“殺了孫堅！拿國寶！”
sentences.pinyin: tā hěn shēng qì duì jūn duì dà shēng shuō shā le sūn jiān ná guó bǎo
sentences.english: He was very angry and shouted to the troops, “Kill Sun Jian! Get the national treasure!”

sentence_translations: Going Home
“Jiangdong is ahead! Everybody run!” Sun Jian said loudly.
Sun Jian was followed by more than 200 men. They were all exerting effort to run forwards.
These 200 or so men were Sun Jian’s troops and Jiangdong, in front of them, was their home.
Several months previously, Sun Jian had brought his troops out of Jiangdong to fight Dong Zhuo alongside other troops in the country.
After fighting Dong Zhuo, Sun Jian then brought his troops back to Jiangdong.
When they left Jiangdong, Sun Jian had more than 10,000 troops, but now there were only 200 or so.
The loss of men was not because of Dong Zhuo, as Sun Jian had never lost a battle against Dong Zhuo.
Sun Jian lost troops on the way back because of a man named Liu Biao.
Liu Biao’s home was in Jingzhou, which was very close to Jiangdong.
Jingzhou was a large city in the south, and Liu Biao was the most important person in Jingzhou.
Two days previously, Liu Biao and his troops were waiting for Sun Jian on his way back to Jiangdong.
Liu Biao said that Sun Jian had a national treasure, and he wanted Sun Jian to give him the national treasure.
Sun Jian said he didn’t have it. Liu Biao didn’t believe him, so he wanted to fight Sun Jian.
Liu Biao thought that after he defeated Sun Jian, he could get the national treasure from him.
The national treasure was very important. It was used by emperors hundreds of years ago, and it was also used by the current emperor.
Many people believed that whoever had the national treasure could become the emperor.
In this restless country, everyone wanted to be the emperor, and everyone wanted the national treasure.
Liu Biao had many men, and Sun Jian had few men.
Sun Jian had no choice but to keep fighting while fleeing towards Jiangdong with his troops.
They fought for two days and fled for two days, and Sun Jian had fewer and fewer men.
The mountains ahead were not high. Jiangdong was on the other side of the mountains.
When they reached Jiangdong, everyone would be safe.
But right now, everyone was extremely tired. The horses were also extremely tired. They had all slowed down.
Liu Biao’s troops caught up very quickly.
Even though Liu Biao had already killed many men, he had not yet obtained the national treasure.
He was very angry and shouted to the troops, “Kill Sun Jian! Get the national treasure!”
